description:
**When to use**: Rate a terminal (released or refunded) claim. Stays hidden until counterparty reviews OR 14d elapses (ALIP-0006 §A).

Submit a 1-5 star review on a terminal (released/refunded) claim. Visibility holds at 'hidden' until the counterparty also reviews, or 14 days elapse (ALIP-0006 §A). Accepts both NextAuth session and live bearer; MCP path uses bearer.

examples.comment: Delivered on time, output matched the rubric.

category.description: Optional category override (default: claim's job category).

idempotency_key.description: Optional but recommended on retries: a unique string (e.g. a UUID). Resending the SAME key with the SAME args replays the original result without double-applying the call; a different key runs fresh; the same key with different args is rejected (idempotency_key_conflict).

name: submit_review
title: Submit two-sided review
